summary_en: Public tender offer by World Holdings for nms Holdings shares closed 2026-07-10. Tendered shares: 11,825,411 (61.54% of S/O ex-treasury). Minimum acceptance threshold 6,480,800 shares exceeded. World Holdings becomes parent company effective 2026-07-17 (settlement start). Offeror held 6,319,700 shares (32.91%) prior to tender.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Public Tender Offer for Shares of nms Holdings Corporation by World Holdings Corporation and Change in Parent Company
translation_en_brief: World Holdings Corporation conducted a public tender offer for nms Holdings shares from 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-10. The tender offer closed on 2026-07-10 with 11,825,411 shares tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 6,480,800 shares. The offer was therefore successful. As a result of the tender, World Holdings will become the parent company of nms Holdings effective 2026-07-17 (settlement start date), as its ownership stake will exceed 50% of voting rights. Prior to the tender offer, World Holdings held 6,319,700 shares (32.91% ownership). World Holdings is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, with stated business interests in human resources education, real estate, information technology, and agricultural parks. The two companies had entered into a capital and business alliance agreement dated 2025-03-10 and were already collaborating in personnel business operations.
